sources.title: Video_understanding.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: Video understanding with Gemini Gemini has from the beginning been a multimodal model, capable of analyzing all sorts of medias using its long context window. Gemini models bring video analysis to a whole new level as illustrated in this video. Note: This notebook uses the Interactions API, the latest way to interact with Gemini models.

sources.snippet: Video Understanding with Qwen3-VL In this notebook, we delve into the capabilities of the Qwen3-VL model for video understanding tasks. Our objective is to showcase how this advanced model can be applied to various video analysis scenarios.
